description_ar: عرض إنجازات وإحصائيات: عدّادات كبيرة تعدّ تصاعدياً مع تسميات واضحة وشرائط تقدم.
description_en: Show achievements and statistics: large counters that count up with clear labels and progress bars.
scene_blueprint_en: A heading scene, then one scene with 3 counters side by side (landscape) or stacked (portrait) starting 0.5-0.6 s apart.
Each counter: from 0 to the value with a suffix (+ or %), a label below in muted color.
Close with a summary line and a thin progress bar.
rules_en: Counters use digits: 'arabic' for Arabic content.
Never more than 3 counters per screen.
